Selected work.

Things I’ve built.

AUTONOMOUS ROBOTICS · ARDUINO

RC & Autonomous Car

An Arduino UNO R4 WiFi vehicle with manual and autonomous modes. A DC motor drives it, a servo steers it, and an ultrasonic sensor measures the distance ahead so it can decide which way to go. Programmed in C++.

HOW IT WORKS
  • Runs in two modes: manual RC control and a fully autonomous mode.
  • An ultrasonic sensor measures the distance ahead, and the code uses that reading to choose which way to turn.
  • A DC motor drives the car and a servo handles steering, all controlled from C++ on the UNO R4 WiFi.
Open in Tinkercad
FIRST PROJECT · ARDUINO

Birthday

An Arduino Uno build with randomly flashing LEDs, a buzzer that plays the birthday song, and a 16×2 LCD that says Happy Birthday.

HOW IT WORKS
  • The Arduino flashes three LEDs, each with its own 220 Ω resistor, in a random pattern.
  • A buzzer plays the birthday song.
  • A 16×2 LCD in 4-bit mode shows “Happy Birthday,” with a potentiometer to adjust the contrast.
Open in Tinkercad
ARDUINO · GAME LOGIC

Memory Game

A Simon-style memory game on an Arduino Uno. Five LEDs flash a random pattern, you repeat it on five push buttons, and it gets harder through 15 levels. A 16×2 LCD shows your level.

HOW IT WORKS
  • Five LEDs flash a random pattern, and the player repeats it on five push buttons.
  • Each button has a 10 kΩ pull-down resistor so the Arduino reads a clean on or off signal.
  • The game gets harder across 15 levels, and a 16×2 LCD shows the current level.
